tagline: Enabling technology inflections for a better future
hero_kpi_rationale: The Semiconductor Systems segment, representing 73% of revenue, is directly driven by investments in AI and data center technologies, particularly through foundry/logic customers. This is the primary driver of structural growth.

kpis.name: AI/Cloud revenue segment
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue linked to investments in AI servers and data centers, captured through foundry and logic customers.
kpis.description: Customer spending in foundry and logic increased in 2025 due to investments in leading-edge technologies for AI and data centers.
kpis.signal: 73% of revenue comes from foundry, logic and others: at the core of the AI wave.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, indicating profitability on sales after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 1.2 points in 2025, driven by higher average selling prices and lower material costs.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion得益于 improved customer and product mix.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin increased slightly despite $181 million in restructuring charges, reflecting strong operational discipline.
kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite costly restructuring.

kpis.name: R&D investments as % of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by $337 million in 2025, supported by hiring and amortization, representing 12.6% of revenue.
kpis.signal: R&D on the rise, critical to maintaining technological leadership in advanced technologies.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Capex rose to $1.8 billion in 2025, reflecting investments in production capacity and innovation.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing, aligned with growing semiconductor demand.

kpis.name: Total employee headcount
kpis.description: The company launched a plan to reduce its global workforce by approximately 4% in Q4 2025, aimed at improving productivity.
kpis.signal: 4% headcount reduction as part of a restructuring initiated in Q4 2025.

kpis.name: Foundry, logic and other revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue from foundry, logic and other segments, key drivers of AI innovation.
kpis.description: In 2025, 67% of Semiconductor Systems segment revenue came from foundry, logic and others, compared to 68% in 2024.
kpis.signal: 67% of revenue from foundry/logic, core of advanced technologies.

kpis.name: NAND Flash memory revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue related to NAND memory equipment, growing with AI.
kpis.description: The share of revenue from NAND Flash memory increased from 4% in 2024 to 7% in 2025, driven by investments in manufacturing equipment.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in NAND share, fueled by demand for high-bandwidth memory for AI.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

ai_positioning.summary: AMAT positions AI and data centers as key drivers of structural growth. The company explicitly cites customer investments in AI servers, data centers, high-bandwidth memory, and edge AI computing as major drivers of demand for semiconductor equipment.
evidence: Customers products are used in artificial intelligence (AI) and data center servers
Foundry and logic customers spending in fiscal 2025 increased driven primarily by higher customer investments in leading-edge manufacturing technologies
Continued demand for AI and data center computing
Data center AI, edge AI and the internet of things, robotics and electric and autonomous vehicles will continue to create the next wave of growth for semiconductors
Semiconductor Systems segment driven by customer investments in foundry/logic for AI and data center technologies
Investments by semiconductor equipment customers are expected to remain strong with growth in the adoption of high-bandwidth memory and other forms of advanced packaging
